C0830.title: Fake OpenAI Cryptocurrency Wallet Phishing Attack
C0830.summary: Attackers exploited the popularity of ChatGPT, GPT-4, and OpenAI by using phishing emails and social media scams to promote fake OpenAI tokens, inducing users to visit phishing sites or connect cryptocurrency wallets. Such activity uses popular AI branding, limited-time airdrops, and token issuance narratives to create credibility and aims to steal wallet authorization, induce asset transfers, or collect credentials, reflecting the risk of generative-AI hype being used in crypto-asset phishing and social-distribution scams.

references.title: Tenable: OpenAI's ChatGPT and GPT-4 used as lure in fake token airdrop phishing scams
